_comment: RigCheck by ShackDesk — USB serial device database. VID/PID identify the USB-to-serial chip in a cable or radio, not usually the radio itself; entries hint at what the chip is commonly found in and suggest presets to try. CableHint may be plain text or a Strings.resx key. Validate JSON at jsonlint.com before submitting. Community entries welcome — see CONTRIBUTING.md.

CableHint: Silicon Labs CP210x — built into many Icom radios (IC-7300, IC-705) and used by DigiRig
Silicon Labs CP2105 dual serial — built into Icom radios with two virtual COM ports (IC-7610, IC-9700)
Silicon Labs CP2108 quad serial — multi-port radio interfaces
FTDI FT232R — very common in CAT and PTT cables for all radio brands
FTDI FT231X — newer FTDI serial chip, common in CAT cables
CH340 — inexpensive USB serial, common in low-cost CAT cables; needs the CH340 driver
Prolific PL2303 — generic USB serial adapter; older chips need a legacy driver on Windows 10/11
Yaesu SCU-17 USB interface — CAT and audio for Yaesu radios
